outputs.explanation: These are spatial heatmap overlays on tissue micrographs showing cell-type deconvolution scores per spot; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

This is a box plot showing distribution statistics (median, quartiles, min/max); box plots are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement (and individual points are in fact also overlaid here).
This is a GSEA enrichment line plot; line plots are exempt because overlaying individual points would make them unreadable.

Bar heights represent log2 fold-change values (an effect-size statistic from differential expression analysis) rather than a mean across a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable here.
This panel shows representative H&E and IHC micrographs/photographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
